content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Employed candidates without a No Objection Certificate will not be allowed to appear in the interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary post, filled initially for a period of one year Purely on contract basis; no right for regular appointment Contract valid for the remaining duration of the project Appointment can be terminated with one month notice from either side Leaves as per ICMR policy for project

content_sections.heading: How Will MAIDS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification (9:00 AM) Interview (10:30 AM) Document verification at 9:00 AM Interview at 10:30 AM Decision of the Competent Authority on selection is final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format with recent passport size photograph Photocopies of certificates and original documents Self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates Self-attested supporting documents of work experience Supporting documents of research work, publications, scholarships or fellowships No Objection Certificate from employer (candidates already employed)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the prescribed format given with the notice. Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form. Bring the filled form with photocopies of certificates and original documents to the walk-in interview. Report at Room no 701, Phase-2, 7th Floor, MAIDS on 20.11.2026 at 9:00 AM for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Age and experience reckoned as on the date of interview Late or incomplete applications will be rejected without communication No TA/DA for interview or joining Competent Authority may change vacancies, withdraw the process or reject applications Follow www.maids.delhi.gov.in for further updates

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 20 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MAIDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 20 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 20 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MDS in Oral and Maxillofacial Pathology from a recognized University. Desirable: previous research experience in related field.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with Provisional Degree Certificate can also apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employed candidates without a No Objection Certificate will not be allowed to appear in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document verification (9:00 AM). Interview (10:30 AM). Document verification at 9:00 AM. Interview at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary post, filled initially for a period of one year. Purely on contract basis; no right for regular appointment. Contract valid for the remaining duration of the project.
